description: This file defines API routes for authentication processes including user registration, login, and retrieving current user information for a FastAPI-based backend. It specifies route handlers, request/response schemas, and interacts with authentication services and database sessions.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI class used to define API route groups for authentication endpoints.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request containing email and password.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Schema for registration request with email and password.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Schema for JWT token response after login.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Schema for user data returned in responses.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class handling authentication logic such as user registration, login, and user retrieval.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )
methods.description: API endpoint to register a new user, creating a user record with hashed password and handling related exceptions.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )
methods.description: API endpoint to authenticate a user and issue a JWT token upon successful login.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

ctags.name: get_me
ctags.signature: ( user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )

ctags.name: login
ctags.signature: ( payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.signature: ( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), auth_service: AuthService = Depends(AuthService), )
